column1: # Disposition of closed rrnewton/hermit PRs that the coalesce guard could not
# classify from their close comment alone (the 45 REFUSE_UNKNOWN rows measured
# 2026-08-07). Hand-classified by reading the FULL comment thread, not the last
# comment -- last-comment-only is what produced the UNKNOWNs, because a later
# reply often sits on top of the closing rationale (see #1703).
# SUPERSEDED  the work survives at a named, identifiable place -> safe to fold.
# MERITS      an owner decided it must not land -> NEVER re-land.
# UNKNOWN     not determinable from the record -> stays refused, fail closed.
# UNKNOWN is a real answer here, not a gap to be filled by inference: a wrong
# SUPERSEDED is precisely what re-lands rejected work.
